National Museum, Delhi (Janpath) is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today is Wed 28 Oct, so it opens at 10:00 AM and closes at 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. The museum's own page says tickets can be booked online at zoonga.com/national-museum. This comes from the museum's official page, which does not show when it was last updated, so check before a special day or festival.
